dct_description_sm: The main objective of the Canadian Science Writers' Association Annual Conference is to bring together Canada's top science journalists and science communicators, policy makers, and First Nations and northern community members to discuss research performed in the areas of climate change, northern science and knowledge, aboriginal self-government and traditional knowledge, circumpolar responsibilities and linkages, and health and medical research.
